name: Default
shortDescription: End-to-end encrypted collaborative office suite with rich text, code, kanban, forms and a shared drive, served on a main and a sandbox domain.

alerts.message: After the first start, open the install link printed in the container logs (https://<your domain>/install/#<token>) to create the first administrator account.

CryptPad loads its editors from a second hostname, sandbox.<your domain>. It must resolve to this server with HTTPS. If you change the domains, update CPAD_MAIN_DOMAIN and CPAD_SANDBOX_DOMAIN to match, otherwise pages stay blank.
